answer: Each account must first hold a licence for one registered charcoal burn. The holder stacks one cord of timber on a knoll below a mesa and burns it to charcoal, and the burner weighs the yield and signs the burn record. Two verifiers check the record against the forestry register within a week; a record tied to a second account voids both. Licence and timber cost 3,000,000 rupiah per burn, so 1,000 fake identities would burn 3,000,000,000 rupiah.
